what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1961?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1961 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (128 pages) was searched for wage, gross, payroll and salary and found only the accountant's wage lines inside departments (p30-40), the count `Number of persons on payroll 146 | 321` (p15) and the Superintendent's prose on salary levels (p92), no per-employee pay; the School Personnel list (p115-119) names staff, years and year appointed and prints no pay (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1961 payroll register (totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in 1961?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1961 report prints no schedule and no classification plan: searched salary schedule, classification, grade and step across all pages; the only hits are the accountant's `Summary and Classification of Accounts` (p30) and the Superintendent's prose that the school salary schedule is `competitive` (p92, no rates) (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Selectmen's or Personnel Board's salary vote in effect for 1961, or the School Committee's salary schedule.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1961, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1961 report prints no such schedule; the words special revenue and revolving do not occur anywhere in the text. Funds appear only as lines of the balance sheet (p20-21 `School Lunch Program 14.50`, `School Athletic Program 3,898.57`), as receipts (p25 `Lunch Room Receipts 47,018.26`, `Athletic Program 4,384.32`) and inside the School Department's own reports (p114 athletic account, p124 lunch program) (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1961 ledger for the school lunch and athletic accounts.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1961?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1961 report prints no such schedule: the word capital does not occur in the text. The school addition's cost to completion is printed (p68, landed as `report-capital-project-costs`), the loan authorizations are in the balance sheet (p21) and the unexpended article balances in the accountant's schedule (p30-41); whether any project sat in a separate fund is not shown (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1961 ledger of the special article accounts.

what: What was Lunenburg's assessed valuation by property class, its levy, overlay and new growth for 1961?
why: `report-valuation` holds valuation and the tax levy by class from the 2000-2010 reports. The 1961 report prints the total assessed valuation, its real estate and personal property split and the tax rate as text on p8 (real estate $9,629,410; personal property $552,915; rate $78.00) and the six-year valuation and rate on p11, and the overlay appears only as a reserve line of the balance sheet (p21 `Overlays Reserved for Abatements: Tax Levy of 1961 5,020.71`); no levy computation, new growth or class split beyond real and personal. Searched overlay, recapitulation, growth and class: no further hit (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Assessors' 1961 tax rate recapitulation filed with the State.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1961, and what did sealing bring in by device?
why: `report-weights-measures` and `report-fee-schedule` read the Sealer's counts and fees from the 2003-2004 reports. The 1961 report prints the Sealer's page as prose only (p51): 163 devices adjusted and sealed and a net cost to the Town of $524.12, no count by device type and no fee by device; the Treasurer's receipts show `Sealer's Fees 92.20` (p25). Searched sealer, weights and measures (sources/data/report-tables/1961/). — closes: the Inspector of Weights and Measures' 1961 test and fee record.
